__NOTOC__
{{Recipe summary
| Category = Soup recipes
| Servings = 5–6
| Time = 1 hour and 10 minutes
| Difficulty = 3
| Image = [[File:Plat de Ndolè avec Plantains Tapés Frits +Poisson Frit.jpg|300px|Plat_de_Ndolè_avec_Plantains_Tapés_Frits_+Poisson_Frit]]
}}

{{Recipe}}

'''Ndole''' is a popular traditional [[Cookbook:Soup|soup]] recipe in Cameroon that is made with the combination of spinach and bitter leaves as well as crayfish, shrimp, and beef. It is also a recipe for ceremony.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2016-11-24 |title=Tasty Ndole Recipe (Cameroon Bitterleaf Casserole) - African Food Network |url=https://afrifoodnetwork.com/recipes/soup-stew-recipes/ndole/ |access-date=2023-07-01 |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Ingredients ==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] stew [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] 
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Dehydrated Broth|maggi]] (stock cube) 
* 3 large [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] 
* ½ pound [[Cookbook:Stockfish|stockfish]] (optional) 
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] shelled and peeled [[Cookbook:Peanut|peanuts]] 
* 4–5 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] 
* ¾ cup [[Cookbook:Ground Crayfish|ground crayfish]] 
* 1 pound [[Cookbook:Bitter Leaf|bitter leaves]] or [[Cookbook:Spinach|spinach]] 

* 2–3 cups [[Cookbook:Oil|oil]]
* ½ pound [[Cookbook:Shrimp|shrimp]]

== Equipment ==

* Pot
* Bowl
* [[Cookbook:Cooktop|Stovetop]]
* [[Cookbook:Knife|Knife]]
* Cooking spoon
* [[Cookbook:Blender|Blender]]/grinder
* [[Cookbook:Saucepan|Saucepan]]
* [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|Frying pan]]

== Procedure ==

# Season the beef in a big pot with salt, maggi, and one-third of the onions, then [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] until the meat is soft. 
# In the meantime, boil the stockfish with salt and water, then add it to the cooked beef. From the meat and stockfish you should get roughly 3 cups. Freeze or reserve the remainder.
# In a saucepan, boil the peanuts for around 10 minutes. Let it cool before pulsing or mixing it in a blender. Add to the meat and stockfish mixture.
# Grind half the remaining onion and garlic to a paste, then stir into the meat and peanut mixture.
# Add the crayfish, then boil it for 10 minutes, stirring often to avoid burning. Season with salt and maggi to taste. Later, you might need to add more.
# Add spinach or bitter leaves to the soup. Stir and continue to [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for few minutes.
# Heat the oil in a frying pan while the ndole is simmering. Add the shrimp and stir continuously until they start to turn pink. Add all the remaining onions and stir again for a few more minutes.
# Add the shrimp and onion mixture to the soup pot, and stir continuously for about 2 minutes
# Serve hot.<ref>{{Cite web |last=ImmaculateBites |date=2016-09-20 |title=Ndole (Spinach/Bitterleaves and Peanut Soup) |url=https://www.africanbites.com/ndole/ |access-date=2023-07-01 |website=Immaculate Bites |language=en-US}}</ref>
